en.headline: Two Belvedere Garden blocks lose power for nearly three hours
en.dek: Blocks 5 and 6 in Tsuen Wan suffered an outage from about 9 p.m. Thursday that cut air-conditioning and lighting; CLP restored supply around midnight as residents gathered downstairs to escape the heat.
body: Two residential blocks at Belvedere Garden in Tsuen Wan lost power for nearly three hours on Thursday night.

The outage struck Blocks 5 and 6 around 9 p.m., cutting off air-conditioning, fans and lighting in many flats. With temperatures near 29 degrees Celsius, residents left their units and gathered on the ground floor to cool off. Lifts and the lobby remained powered, so no one was trapped.
CLP Power dispatched crews for emergency repairs. Supply was gradually restored by about midnight. The cause of the outage remains under investigation.
A resident of Block 6 who has lived there for more than 20 years said the sudden blackout was unprecedented in her experience.

zh.headline: 荃灣麗城花園兩座停電近三小時 居民下樓避暑
zh.dek: 第5座及第6座周四晚約9時停電，冷氣及照明受影響，中電至約午夜復電；不少居民因室內酷熱下樓透氣。
body: 荃灣麗城花園兩幢大廈周四晚一度停電近三小時。
約晚上9時，第5座及第6座突然停電，多個單位的冷氣機、風扇及照明停止運作。當時氣溫接近29度，不少居民離開單位到地下大堂避暑。升降機及大堂仍然有電，無人被困。
中電派員趕赴現場搶修，約午夜前後陸續恢復供電。停電原因仍在調查。
一名在第6座居住超過20年的居民表示，過往從未遇過類似突然停電的情况。
